decisions.reason: The award-winning fruit-bottom yogurt draws directly on the firm's core cultured-dairy know-how, so management can read its market signals and refine it, though no website presence since 2018 slightly raises the risk of rotation.
As a flagship flavored cheese built on established cheese competence, it is a product the firm can interpret and improve in-house, which justifies keeping it despite the lack of recent visibility.

A semi-hard cheese wheel is a close extension of existing production knowledge and affiliated organic milk supply, so it remains low-risk to keep, even after the firm pruned its more specialized cheeses in 2019.
